def _calibrate(a, frequency):
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    design = np.column_stack((_aff(u), np.sin(frequency * u)))
    magnitude = np.max(np.abs(v), axis=1)
    keep = magnitude <= 2.5 * np.median(magnitude)
    if keep.sum() < design.shape[1] + 2:
        keep = np.ones(len(u), dtype=bool)
    for _ in range(5):
        q = _ls(design[keep], v[keep])
        residual = np.linalg.norm(design @ q - v, axis=1)
        new_keep = residual <= max(0.015, 5 * np.median(residual))
        if new_keep.sum() < design.shape[1] + 2 or np.array_equal(keep, new_keep):
            break
        keep = new_keep
    return q

def _operator(study, x):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (offsets, scales) = ([], [])
    for j in range(u.shape[1]):
        d = _aff(u[:, j:j + 1])
        q = _ls(d, v[:, j])
        for _ in range(8):
            keep = np.argsort(abs(d @ q - v[:, j]))[:int(len(u) * 0.875)]
            q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        err = abs(d @ q - v[:, j])
        keep = err <= max(10 * np.median(err), 0.002)
        q = _ls(d[keep], v[keep, j])
        offsets.append(q[0])
        scales.append(q[1])
    b = study['panel_b']
    return _aff((x - offsets) / scales) @ _ls(_aff(b['u']), b['v'])

def solve_batch(study):
    (tr, te) = (study['train'], study['test'])
    w = _operator(study, np.concatenate((tr['x'], te['x']), axis=0))
    y = 0.35 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'asinh') + 0.65 * _predict(w, tr['y'], True, 'atan')
    p = _predict(w, tr['traj'], False, 'inv3')
    tail = p[:, -1]
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': p, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), tail.mean(), tail.std()])}
